title: Shipping label buy/print: instant feedback, clear failure reason, offer print after buy
requested_outcome: George asked why buying and printing three ready labels was slow, why he couldn't print right after buying, and why the #2202 label broke. Each action_commit tap for shipping_label_buy took nine to eleven seconds to answer with nothing shown while it worked — the tap should answer at once and show the work under way. The #2202 label buy failed as "unverified" and was retried, failing the same way again, with no reason shown at the control — it should say the specific reason once (e.g. "unverified, confirming with provider, do not retry") and not invite a blind retry. There is no path from a successful label buy straight to printing it: buying and printing are two separate gestures with no prompt offering the print once the buy lands. Fix: immediate in-flight feedback on the buy tap; the specific failure reason surfaced on the card instead of a generic refusal; and after a label buy is confirmed bought, offer the print step on the same card or chain to it. Nothing else about shipping should change.
acceptance_criteria: A shipping_label_buy action_commit tap shows an in-flight state immediately, before the provider call resolves.
A failed/unverified label buy shows its specific reason on the card and does not let the same tap retry blindly without that reason shown.
After a shipping_label_buy is confirmed bought, the card offers the print step (shipping_label_print) without a separate request.
The change is proven by tests in crooks-assistant/tests/test_shipping_label_buy_print_instant_feedback.py, and they pass.
